_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley UI.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Chinese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "chinese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, pinyin, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "chinese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

AGO_CCB_Tooltip.chinese: 修改出现在社区中心里的收集包。
AGO_CCB_Tooltip.english: Modifies the collection packs that appear in the Community Center.

AGO_CabinLayout_Tooltip.chinese: 调整小屋之间的距离远近。
AGO_CabinLayout_Tooltip.english: Adjust how far or near the distance between the cabins is.

AGO_FarmMonsters_Tooltip.english: Allows monsters to appear at night.

AGO_LegacyRandomization_Tooltip.chinese: 使用旧版本的伪随机算法，大多数玩家无需开启。
AGO_LegacyRandomization_Tooltip.english: Uses the old version's pseudo-random algorithm; most players need not turn it on.

AGO_MineTreasureShuffle_Tooltip.english: Modifies the drops in the mines.

AGO_ProfitMargin_Tooltip.english: The multiplier on the selling price of items.

AGO_RandomSeed_Tooltip.chinese: 用于游戏世界随机化的种子。
AGO_RandomSeed_Tooltip.english: The seed used for randomizing the game world.

AGO_Year1Completable.english: Ensure the first year can be completed

AGO_Year1Completable_Tooltip.chinese: 确保旅行商人在第一年的某个时间出售红叶卷心菜种子。
AGO_Year1Completable_Tooltip.english: Ensures the traveling merchant sells red-leaf cabbage seeds at some time in the first year.

Character_CoopHelpString.chinese: 初始联机小屋：开始时已有 1 至 {0} 间联机小屋就位，可让你的朋友立即加入。或者，你可以选择“无”，并（通过罗宾）自己建造联机小屋。^^联机小屋布局：如果你决定用原本存在的联机小屋开始你的农场，则可在两种布局风格之间做选择：“附近”将所有联机小屋都放在主农舍附近，鼓励社区型耕种风格。“独立”将尽可能拉开联机小屋之间的距离，提供更多的独立空间。^^利润率：调节你所出售商品的利润率（你赚的钱）。“普通”是原汁原味的星露谷体验。经验较丰富和/或规模较大的团队员可能会压低利润。
Character_CoopHelpString.english: Starting cabins: start with 1 to {0} cabins already in place, letting your friends join right away. Or you can choose "none" and build cabins yourself (through Robin). Cabin layout: if you decide to start your farm with existing cabins, you can choose between two layout styles: "nearby" puts all cabins near the main farmhouse, encouraging a community-style farming. "Separate" spaces the cabins as far apart as possible, giving more independent space. Profit margin: adjusts the profit margin (the money you earn) on goods you sell. "Normal" is the original Stardew Valley experience. More experienced and/or larger teams may lower the profit.

Character_CoopHelpString2.chinese: 资金管理：你可以选择收支管理的方式。在“共享”模式下，所有玩家共享同一个资金池。在“独立”模式下，每个玩家都有自己的单独的资金池。“共享”模式是经典的星露谷物语体验模式。
Character_CoopHelpString2.english: Money management: you can choose how income and spending are managed. In "shared" mode, all players share the same money pool. In "separate" mode, each player has their own separate money pool. "Shared" mode is the classic Stardew Valley experience.

Character_FarmBeach.chinese: 海滩农场_采集与钓鱼的好去处，还有成片的空地。有时会有补给箱冲到沙滩上。但是，洒水器在沙土上没有用。
Character_FarmBeach.english: Beach farm _ A good place for foraging and fishing, with large stretches of open land. Sometimes supply crates wash up on the beach. However, sprinklers don't work on sandy soil.

Character_FarmCombat.chinese: 荒野农场_这里到处都是肥沃的土地，但一定要小心……在夜间有怪物出没。
Character_FarmCombat.english: Wilderness farm _ There's fertile land everywhere here, but be careful... monsters appear at night.

Character_FarmFishing.chinese: 河边农场_你的农场散布在几座岛屿和风景优美的河岸之间。这里的鱼要比其他地方更多。开始时有一台熏鱼机。
Character_FarmFishing.english: Riverside farm _ Your farm is spread across several islands and scenic riverbanks. There are more fish here than elsewhere. You start with a fish smoker.

Character_FarmForaging.chinese: 森林农场_树木把你农场的空间给限制住了。但是，森林的馈赠就几乎在你的门口……
Character_FarmForaging.english: Forest farm _ Trees limit your farm's space. But the forest's gifts are almost at your doorstep...

Character_FarmFourCorners.chinese: 四角农场_土地分为四个地块，每个地块都有各自的补贴。非常适合多人游戏！
Character_FarmFourCorners.english: Four corners farm _ The land is divided into four plots, each with its own bonus. Very suited to multiplayer!

Character_FarmMining.chinese: 山顶农场_岩石地形和蜿蜒的河流提高了你设计农场的难度。但是矿床提供了不少采矿的机会。
Character_FarmMining.english: Hilltop farm _ Rocky terrain and a winding river make your farm harder to design. But a mineral deposit offers plenty of mining opportunities.

Character_FarmStandard.chinese: 标准农场_一块简单的地，有大量空间可以设计你的农场。
Character_FarmStandard.english: Standard farm _ A simple piece of land, with lots of space to design your farm.
